AgentAssessment.description:
The agent's written record of one supervision turn.

This is deliberately not how the agent acts: acting is a
`PrintAction` that policy rules on.

disposition.description:
What the turn's event is acknowledged with, when the turn acknowledged
nothing by command.

escalating.description: Whether the agent is escalating to a person.

should_continue.description: Whether the print should carry on.

summary.description: One line saying what is happening.

Confidence.description:
How sure the agent is.

A closed vocabulary rather than a number, because a number invites a
precision the agent does not have.

Disposition.description:
What the agent's answer asks for next, in the vocabulary an
acknowledgement's disposition is spelled in.

A turn that acknowledged nothing by command is acknowledged from its
answer with this, so a quiet check records its judgement without a command
of its own.

oneOf.description: Carry on printing, watched more closely.

description: The agent wrote down what it made of a turn.

session_name.description: The session the turn ran in.
